evidence.V1: Front, three-quarter and silhouette all read instantly as a spear (leaf head, cross-wings, banded grip, bulb butt); top view is only a dot+bar, which is inherent to a long weapon; outline is mirror-symmetric (A15 X/Y error 0.0).
evidence.V2: Clear tiers: big = leaf head + long haft, medium = gold socket cone, wings, butt collar and bulb, small = three ink grip bands with teal spacers and the teal ring under the socket.
evidence.V3: Head is a nicely stylised leaf with a central ridge, but the haft is a uniform straight cylinder and the wings are plain rectangular slabs, so the overall shape is only partly exaggerated rather than confidently stylised.
evidence.V4: Consistent chamfers catch light on wing slabs, socket collar, teal ring and butt collar; blade has an even edge-bevel band around the leaf; no razor edges.
evidence.V5: Minor faceting: socket cone and butt bulb show polygonal outlines and stepped shading in the studio/flat close-ups, faint vertical banding on the haft, and a small pinch at the blade tip; no z-fighting or patches.
evidence.V6: Disciplined: steel-grey blade, gold accent, teal haft in two values plus ink bands; colourways (crimson, shadow) swap only the hue and stay clean.
evidence.V7: 1,896 tris vs weapon target 2,500 (ceiling 4,000): at/under target.
evidence.V8: One white LF_VertexColor material with vertex colours, kit gold/ink/teal/steel palette, chamfered edges and smooth shading match the kit anchors.
evidence.V9: Studio line correct: Tool Handle, origin at grip, CollisionFidelity Hull, CanCollide off when equipped, Massless, MeshPart.Color white, SmoothPlastic.
